design.title: Design system
design.lead: Every token, component and state in one place. Generated from packages/tokens/tokens.json — never hard-coded.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: The Linkyo y: a Linkyo Teal tile with a y whose long stroke ends in a soft hook. The short stroke stops just before it: the point where two paths connect. Calm, precise, premium.
brand.lockupsNote: Horizontal, symbol + wordmark, on Ink and on Linkyo Teal (then in white). Clear space equals a quarter of the tile.
brand.appIconNote: A white y on flat Linkyo Teal, no gradient. Light, dark and tinted appearances for iOS 18+.

color.title: Color
color.description: Warm paper, deep ink, one deep teal. Spark is rare: live moments and celebration only.
color.scalesNote: Generated in OKLCH around the brand anchors, which stay exact.
color.rolesNote: Components use roles, never scale steps. Ratios are measured on surface in light / dark mode.

type.title: Typography
type.description: Geist for UI and body, Geist Mono for numbers. Self-hosted — no Google Fonts CDN.
type.familiesNote: Arabic glyphs fall through to IBM Plex Sans Arabic automatically.

layout.title: Space, shape & depth
layout.description: 4 px base, 8 px rhythm. Flat: borders and fills, never shadows.
layout.spacingNote: Only these steps exist in the theme. Anything else fails the build.
layout.depthNote: Linkyo uses no shadows. A surface stands apart with a hairline border, a stronger border for fields, or a step in the fill.
layout.gridNote: Creator column, dashboard regions and touch targets (px).

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Motion explains, never decorates. With Reduce Motion, movement becomes a fade.
motion.durationsNote: Press Play. Turn on Reduce Motion in your OS to see the opacity fallback.
motion.principle1: Micro (120 ms) for hover, press and toggles.
motion.principle3: Slow (320 ms) for sheets and pages. Drag lifts to 1.03 with e3.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Lucide on the web, SF Symbols on iOS. One family per screen, labeled when it matters.
icons.uiNote: The stroke is measured in real pixels and grows a little with the size. Always in the colour of the text.
icons.platformsNote: Simple Icons in official shapes. Monochrome by default, brand color on hover.
icons.registryNote: Screens take the meaning from the registry (<bdi>icons.analytics</bdi>), never a <bdi>Lucide</bdi> name. No meaning has two icons, no icon has two meanings.
icons.directionalNote: Arrows, chevrons, undo, send and sign out point in the reading direction. In Arabic they mirror by themselves, exactly once.
icons.sizesNote: Four sizes. At every size the stroke stays as strong as the text next to it.
icons.weightsNote: The selected tab gets the stronger stroke and a semibold label, never colour alone. Playback icons are always filled.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: One primary action per screen. Verbs first, three words max.
buttons.matrixNote: sm 32 · md 40 · lg 48 · xl 56 (creator page links).
buttons.statesNote: Default, hover, pressed (0.98 + darker), focus (2 px ring, 2 px offset), disabled (40 %), loading.
buttons.loadingNote: Loading keeps the label and the width. Try Publish.
buttons.iconButtonsNote: 40 px on web, 44 pt hit area on touch. Tooltip always — hover or focus one.
buttons.destructiveNote: Danger text in context. A filled button only inside the confirmation dialog.
buttons.confirmBody: It disappears from your page right away. You can undo for a few seconds.

faq.title: Questions, answered

items.a: Yes. All templates, links, sections and cookie-free analytics cost nothing. Pro comes with the launch, with AI drafts for your page.

items.q: Does my page show a cookie banner?
items.a: No. Creator pages set no cookies and load no trackers, so they show no cookie banner. Pages with videos show a slim bar about external content; a YouTube video loads only once someone taps it.
Accounts, pages and pictures are stored at Supabase in Frankfurt, Germany. The privacy policy describes who processes data for us.

items.q: Can I use my own photos, colors and fonts?
items.a: Yes, your own photos and colors; fonts you pick from our font pairings. Start from a template, then change colors, fonts and buttons. Linkyo adjusts the shades so that text stays readable.

items.q: Does it work in Arabic and other right-to-left languages?
items.a: Yes. Every template supports Arabic with a proper Arabic typeface and a mirrored layout.
A native iOS app is in the works: edit your page, add links from the share sheet and see your stats in a widget.

security.title: What Linkyo does with data.
security.lead: This page says what the code does today. The privacy policy is the legally binding text.
security.review: Sentences marked <marker>{text}</marker> have not been checked by a lawyer yet.

items.cookies: Creator pages set no cookies. The only thing stored on a visitor’s device is whether they allowed external content; the counting stores nothing there.
items.thirdParty: On their own they load nothing from other providers: no trackers, no ads, no outside fonts. Pictures, including Spotify and YouTube covers, are served by us.
items.embeds: A YouTube video plays on the page only after a tap, in its privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com). The page does not load videos from TikTok, Instagram or Vimeo, and music blocks are links to the services. “Allow external content” only hides the note on the player; nothing loads before a tap all the same.

items.vercel: The server functions of the website and the creator pages run at Vercel in Frankfurt (fra1); the pages are delivered through Vercel’s global network.
items.supabase: Accounts, pages, uploaded pictures and the stats are stored at Supabase in Frankfurt.

statistics.title: Cookie-free analytics

items.what: We count views, different visitors per day and taps on blocks, plus a rough source (for example Instagram or search engines), the country and the kind of device.
items.script: On a view the counting script sends the page, the domain name of the website a visitor came from, and whether they came by QR code or from the page itself; on a tap it sends which block was tapped. If the browser sends “Do Not Track” or “Global Privacy Control”, it sends nothing.
items.how: So that a person counts only once a day, our server makes a check value from the network address and the browser string with a random key that is new every day (<term>HMAC-SHA-256</term>). We do not store the address or the browser string. Keys and check values are deleted within the first hour after the day ends (Berlin time); only daily totals remain.
items.access: A page’s creator sees all its numbers. Our team sees, per page, only the total views and taps of the last 30 days, never sources, countries or devices.
items.noBanner: Creator pages show no consent banner for this counting.

statistics.off: On this website the counting is switched off right now.

items.off: The AI assistant, which drafts a page from your links, is switched off right now.
items.on: The AI assistant drafts a page from your links.
items.photos: The AI provider gets no photos. Email addresses and phone numbers are removed from every text before it is sent.
items.publish: The AI publishes nothing: you decide what goes on your page.

items.off: Payments are not switched on yet: nothing can be bought on Linkyo right now.
items.stripe: Payments go through Stripe. Stripe’s script loads only on our order pages, on no other page.
items.data: You enter card and account details in Stripe’s form; they go to Stripe, not to us.

items.code: You sign in with a 6-digit code that we send to your email address.
items.signIns: Under “Settings” › “Account” you see your latest sign-ins, with IP address, approximate place and device. We keep them for 30 days.
items.delete: If you delete your account, we delete the account, the page, uploaded pictures and the stats.

willkommen.title: Your first steps
willkommen.summary: After signing up, {steps} short steps lead you to a finished page, {portfolioSteps} for portfolios.
body: First you choose what describes you best, for example TikToker, Music, Local shop or Photographer. We pick a fitting template and ask only what you really need.
Then come your name, a photo and your address, the look and your links. The preview shows your page at every step. You can skip any step and change everything later.
For photography, design, development and similar work there are {portfolioSteps} steps: instead of links we ask for up to three pieces of work and one way to reach you.
Already have a link page on Beacons, bio.link, lnk.bio or Carrd? Paste its address and we take over your profiles and links, if that page allows it to be read.

bloecke.title: Adding content
bloecke.summary: Everything on your page is a block: a link, a video, music, dates, a product and much more.
body: Tap “Add” and paste a link. Linkyo recognizes links from Spotify, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and many more services and turns them into the right block. Several links at once work too.
Or pick a block from the list: from link, text and image through video, music and events to product, project and contact & enquiry.
Upload photos as JPG, PNG or WebP up to 25 MB. One photo becomes an image; with several, Linkyo first asks whether they should become a gallery or a project.
A ticket link does not say when and where: enter the date and the city, and the show appears on your page.
Under “Page” you reorder, edit and delete your blocks. “Undo” takes a change back.

projekte.title: Portfolio: projects with a page of their own
projekte.summary: Show your work as projects. When there is more to tell, the card leads to the project’s own page.
body: Add a “Project” block: a title, one sentence about it and, if you have one, a picture. Add what you have: up to three figures, the story, up to {pictures} pictures with captions, links and a code sample.

Every project has an address of its own under your page. Its card on your page leads there once the project shows more than the card, such as a story, figures, code or several pictures; otherwise it leads to the project’s first link, if it has one. If you change the address, the old one still leads there.
A tap on a picture opens it full size.
For client work there is “Confidential, no name”: your page then says “Confidential”, and we do not store the name.
In the dashboard the “Work” view shows all projects as pictures. Show only work you are allowed to show.

vorlagen.title: Changing templates
vorlagen.summary: {designs} designs, each with its own look. Switch any time; your content stays.
body: Under “Design” you choose the template first. Your blocks, your photo and your texts stay; only the look changes. “Undo” takes you back to the template before.
The gallery shows the designs on example pages. “Use this template” takes the look with you into sign-up.
Portfolios have templates of their own; under “Design” the “Portfolio” filter shows only those.

design.title: Colors, fonts and buttons
design.summary: Pick a color, a light, dark or colored background, fonts and buttons.
body: Under “Design” › “Color” you pick a color from the selection or your own. Linkyo adjusts the shades so that text and buttons stay readable, to the WCAG AA contrast standard.
The background is light, dark or all in your color. Under “Font” and “Buttons” you set the fonts, the button style and their corners.
“Reset to template” brings back the template’s look.

sprachen.title: Languages: German, English, Arabic
sprachen.summary: The dashboard and your page come in German, English and Arabic.
body: “Page language” in Settings decides the language of the buttons, dates and notes on your page. You write your own texts in any language you like.
In Arabic the page reads right to left, with an Arabic typeface that fits its template.
“App language” applies only to you, in this browser.

teilen.title: Sharing your page
teilen.summary: Copy the link, get the QR code or make a picture for stories and posts.
body: Under “Home” you find your link with “Copy link”, “Share”, the QR code and “Image for story & post”.
When you send the link in WhatsApp, iMessage or LinkedIn, the preview shows your photo or your initials, your name and your line.
The QR code comes as a PNG and as an SVG in your page’s color; as an SVG it stays sharp at any size.
The picture for stories and posts shows your photo, name and address in your look, as 9:16 or 4:5.
teilen.counting: Stats count scans as a source of their own, “QR code”.

statistik.title: Stats: how Linkyo counts
statistik.summary: Views, visitors and taps on your blocks, counted without cookies.
body: Under “Stats” you see views, visitors, clicks and click rate for {week}, {month} or {quarter} days, plus where visitors come from, which country and which device. You download the daily numbers as a CSV.

The counting stores nothing on your visitors’ devices. So that a person counts only once a day, our server makes a check value from the network address and the browser string with a key that is new every day. We store neither, and the check values are deleted within the first hour after the day ends. Only daily totals remain.
Visitors who turned on “Do Not Track” or “Global Privacy Control” are not counted, and neither are robots and prefetches. Your own visits count too.

In the editor every block that can be tapped shows how often it was tapped in the last 30 days. You see all your page’s numbers; our team sees, per page, only the total views and taps of the last 30 days, never sources, countries or devices.

datenschutz-seite.title: Privacy on your page
datenschutz-seite.summary: Your page sets no cookies and loads nothing from other providers on its own.
body: Creator pages set no cookies and load no trackers. The only thing stored on a visitor’s device is whether they allowed external content. Pictures, including Spotify and YouTube covers, are served by us.

A YouTube video plays on your page only once a visitor taps it, and then in its privacy-enhanced mode. Your page does not load videos from TikTok, Instagram or Vimeo, and music blocks are links to the services.
At the bottom your page links Linkyo’s privacy notice and, once you have filled it in, your imprint.

impressum.summary: Under “Settings” › “Legal notice” you enter your name, address, email address and phone.
body: It is complete with a name, an address and a valid email address; the phone number is optional.
Once you have filled it in, your page links it at the bottom.

konto-loeschen.title: Exporting your data and deleting your account
konto-loeschen.summary: In Settings you download your data as a JSON file and delete your account.
body: “Export my data” downloads a JSON file with your account, your page and your latest sign-ins, plus, if there are any, your subscription, invoices and invites.

You find “Delete account” under “Settings” › “Account”. To confirm, you type the name in your page address. Your account, your page, your uploaded pictures and your stats are deleted; this cannot be undone.
After that your address no longer works.
